jobs.name: ig30_host
jobs.style: Photorealistic cinematic still shot on a phone held by a friend across the table, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, natural daylight. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
jobs.style_qa: фотореализм, женщина ~45 за столиком в светлом ресторане, смотрит чуть мимо камеры на собеседника (так задумано), губы приоткрыты, без надписей и логотипов
jobs.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real, a confident business owner.
jobs.meaning: владелица бизнеса ~45: каштановое каре, тонкие золотые очки, кремовая шёлковая блуза, светлый ресторан с панорамными окнами
jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame of a conversation in a bright modern restaurant during the day. A confident Russian businesswoman about 45 with a chestnut-brown chin-length bob, thin gold-rimmed glasses, small gold hoop earrings, a cream silk sleeveless blouse, a thin gold necklace, sitting at a light wooden table, forearms on the table, one hand mid-gesture. On the table: a cup of espresso, a closed leather notebook, a phone face down. She looks slightly to the left of the camera at an interlocutor, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, serious and engaged, NO smile. Medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 20% below the upper edge (calm blurred background above her head). Background: large panoramic windows, light columns, warm wooden ceiling, other tables, soft bokeh. Look: a real frame from a phone camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no brand names, no watermark.
